description: This file defines an enumeration 'ConditionClinicalStatus' representing various clinical statuses of a medical condition within the OpenMRS project. It includes statuses like ACTIVE, INACTIVE, HISTORY_OF, RECURRENCE, RELAPSE, REMISSION, and RESOLVED, with associated documentation and deprecation notes.

classes.name: ConditionClinicalStatus
classes.description: An enumeration representing the various states or statuses of a patient's clinical condition, used within the OpenMRS healthcare system.
